import numpy as np
import random

p = 0.3

    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            adj[i][j] = 1
            adj[j][i] = 1

# Local search improvement
def count_cut_edges(partition, adj):
    cut = 0

                cut += 1

            best_cut = new_cut

            if new_cut > current_cut:
                current_cut = new_cut
                improved = True
            else:
                current_partition[vertex] = original_label
        
        if not improved:
            break
    
    if current_cut > best_overall_cut:
        best_overall_cut = current_cut

import numpy as np
import random

# Set seed to generate the same graph
np.random.seed(17)
random.seed(17)

# Generate G(200, 0.3)
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []
adj_matrix = np.zeros((n, n))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))
            adj_matrix[i][j] = 1
            adj_matrix[j][i] = 1

# Convert to adjacency list for efficiency
adj_list = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for i, j in edges:
    adj_list[i].append(j)
    adj_list[j].append(i)

# Greedy local search for MaxCut
def calculate_cut_size(partition, adj_list):
    cut_size = 0
    for i in range(len(partition)):
        for j in adj_list[i]:
            if partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut_size += 1
    return cut_size // 2  # Each edge counted twice

def local_search_maxcut(adj_list, max_iterations=1000):
    n = len(adj_list)
    # Start with random partition
    partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]
    
    current_cut = calculate_cut_size(partition, adj_list)
    
    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        improved = False
        for v in range(n):
            # Try flipping vertex v
            old_contribution = 0
            new_contribution = 0
            
            for neighbor in adj_list[v]:
                if partition[v] != partition[neighbor]:
                    old_contribution += 1
                if partition[v] == partition[neighbor]:  # After flip
                    new_contribution += 1
            
            if new_contribution > old_contribution:
                partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
                current_cut += (new_contribution - old_contribution)
                improved = True
        
        if not improved:
            break
    
    return partition, current_cut

# Try multiple random starts
best_partition = None
best_cut = 0

for trial in range(50):
    partition, cut_size = local_search_maxcut(adj_list)
    if cut_size > best_cut:
        best_cut = cut_size
        best_partition = partition[:]

# Also try a spectral approach as starting point
# Use the Laplacian matrix eigenvector heuristic
degree = np.sum(adj_matrix, axis=1)
laplacian = np.diag(degree) - adj_matrix
eigenvals, eigenvecs = np.linalg.eigh(laplacian)

# Use Fiedler vector (second smallest eigenvalue)
fiedler_vector = eigenvecs[:, 1]
spectral_partition = [1 if x >= np.median(fiedler_vector) else 0 for x in fiedler_vector]

# Improve spectral solution with local search
partition = spectral_partition[:]
for iteration in range(500):
    improved = False
    for v in range(n):
        old_contribution = 0
        new_contribution = 0
        
        for neighbor in adj_list[v]:
            if partition[v] != partition[neighbor]:
                old_contribution += 1
            if partition[v] == partition[neighbor]:
                new_contribution += 1
        
        if new_contribution > old_contribution:
            partition[v] = 1 - partition[v]
            improved = True
    
    if not improved:
        break

spectral_cut = calculate_cut_size(partition, adj_list)
if spectral_cut > best_cut:
    best_partition = partition
    best_cut = spectral_cut
